answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via hardware attestation. Before operating at the market wharf, each agent routes enclave proofs across an attestation bridge to verify its environment. This forces an attacker to incur the verifiable hardware cost of dedicated physical processors per identity, stopping a predatory raven actor from multiplexing cheap virtual clones. However, it relies on centralized chipmakers and remains vulnerable to hardware side-channel attacks.
